brief: Delta: the flush deepened into a 1d breakdown. BTC closed the daily bar at 77947, under the True Market Mean (79625) that hl-cycles named as its invalidation; ETH, SOL, XRP and most alts broke their 1d lows with long_liquidation flow. HYPE is the outlier (ret24h +13.07, funding 164.96). Two low-conviction shorts proposed on retests of broken lows (AAVE, ZRO). Seven yesterday setups closed: DOGE and XPL shorts hit target; ZEC, AAVE, kPEPE longs/shorts stopped. L1/L2 applied: no longs before a reclaim close. What proves it wrong: a 1d BTC close back above 79625 (base case is continuation, low-confidence). Gaps: hl-cycles stale 20.7 h; Oct 28 FOMC and Oct 29 PCE outcomes unverified.
